description: Negation attenuates ideation only, scoped to the clause. It never touches plan, means, timeline or farewell.

cases.text: i'm not going to hurt myself
cases.note: clean denial; floor at 1, never 0 — unprompted denial is itself weak signal

cases.text: i don't want to die, i just want the pain to stop
cases.note: classic presentation; distress without death wish

cases.text: i would never do that to my kids
i'm not suicidal, i'm just exhausted
i'm not going to hurt myself, but i want to die
cases.note: 'but' closes negation scope — second clause scores full

cases.text: i won't do anything, i just bought a lot of pills
no plan, nothing like that, i just can't see a way forward
